announcements.headline: Appointment of Auditor
announcements.insight: BAF appoints a new auditor following the previous auditor's resignation in June. This board change ensures ongoing statutory compliance.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: British American Inv Trust published its Half-year Financial Report. This follows the June resignation of its auditor.

announcements.headline: Resignation of Auditor
announcements.insight: British American Inv Trust has announced the resignation of its auditor. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details regarding the appointment of a replacement firm.
